node.statement: Norm conclusion: positivity and unitality give 0<=S(a* a)<=||a||^2 1. Together with node 1.1.1 this yields ||S(a)||^2=||S(a)*S(a)||<=||a||^2. Hence ||S||<=1 for every r; equality holds on the identity, so ||S||=1 and ||T||_cb=1. Applying this to the root UCP maps gives ||Delta||_cb,||Upsilon||_cb<=1.
